description: This PHP source file defines the KeyHandler class, responsible for creating, reading, and managing cryptographic keys used in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for key generation, file handling, and validation, with exception handling for various error conditions.

classes.name: KeyHandler
classes.description: A utility class that handles creation, retrieval, and validation of cryptographic keys used for encryption within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, saves it to a file, and throws an exception if a key already exists or if there is an error during creation.

methods.name: readKey
methods.description: Reads the cryptographic key from the file, caching it for future use, and throws exceptions if the key does not exist or is not readable.

methods.name: keyExists
methods.description: Checks whether the key file exists.

methods.name: getRealPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the key file if it exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: getPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the configured path to the key file.
